entries.title: Proverbs 30:1
segments: ¶The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, [even] the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

entries.title: Proverbs 30:2
segments: Surely I [am] more brutish than [any] man, and have not the understanding of a man.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:3
segments: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy. {have: Heb. know}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:4
segments: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what [is] his name, and what [is] his son's name, if thou canst tell?

entries.title: Proverbs 30:5
segments: Every word of God [is] pure: he [is] a shield unto them that put their trust in him. {pure: Heb. purified}

words.text: unto them that put their trust

entries.title: Proverbs 30:6
segments: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

words.text: thee, and thou be found a liar

entries.title: Proverbs 30:7
segments: ¶Two [things] have I required of thee; deny me [them] not before I die: {deny...: Heb. withhold not from me}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:8
segments: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me: {convenient...: Heb. of my allowance}

words.text: for me: {convenient...: Heb. of my allowance}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:9
segments: Lest I be full, and deny [thee], and say, Who [is] the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God [in vain]. {deny...: Heb. belie thee}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:10
segments: ¶Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty. {Accuse...: Heb. Hurt not with thy tongue}

words.text: thee, and thou be found guilty
. {Accuse...: Heb. Hurt not with thy tongue}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:11
segments: [There is] a generation [that] curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:12
segments: [There is] a generation [that are] pure in their own eyes, and [yet] is not washed from their filthiness.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:13
segments: [There is] a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:14
segments: [There is] a generation, whose teeth [are as] swords, and their jaw teeth [as] knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from [among] men.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:15
segments: ¶The horseleach hath two daughters, [crying], Give, give. There are three [things that] are never satisfied, [yea], four [things] say not, [It is] enough: {It is...: Heb. Wealth}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:16
segments: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth [that] is not filled with water; and the fire [that] saith not, [It is] enough.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:17
segments: The eye [that] mocketh at [his] father, and despiseth to obey [his] mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it. {the valley: or, the brook}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:18
segments: ¶There be three [things which] are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

entries.title: Proverbs 30:19
segments: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid. {midst: Heb. heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:20
segments: Such [is] the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:21
segments: For three [things] the earth is disquieted, and for four [which] it cannot bear:

entries.title: Proverbs 30:22
segments: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

entries.title: Proverbs 30:23
segments: For an odious [woman] when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:24
segments: ¶There be four [things which are] little upon the earth, but they [are] exceeding wise: {exceeding...: Heb. wise, made wise}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:25
segments: The ants [are] a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

entries.title: Proverbs 30:26
segments: The conies [are but] a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;

entries.title: Proverbs 30:27
segments: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands; {by...: Heb. gathered together}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:28
segments: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.

entries.title: Proverbs 30:29
segments: ¶There be three [things] which go well, yea, four are comely in going:

entries.title: Proverbs 30:30
segments: A lion [which is] strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;

entries.title: Proverbs 30:31
segments: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom [there is] no rising up. {greyhound: or, horse: Heb. girt in the loins}

words.text: , against whom [there is] no rising up
. {greyhound: or, horse: Heb. girt in the loins}

entries.title: Proverbs 30:32
segments: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, [lay] thine hand upon thy mouth.

words.text: thyself, or if thou hast thought evil

entries.title: Proverbs 30:33
segments: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
